integrity: Exact analytical polynomial transfer derivation and finite exact-rational forward-branch checks; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: For full-height skew tent maps with independent identically distributed switching and Lebesgue-stationary coordinates; annealed lag correlations only; operator non-diagonalizability is proved on the invariant centered quadratic polynomial subspace, not claimed as an isolated spectral resonance of the full BV transfer operator. Sources with uninspected full text may contain equivalent specializations, and independent evaluation is outstanding.
title: Noise-induced quadratic Jordan resonance in randomly switched skew tent maps
